# Masterclass: Agentic Software Engineering with Claude Code

Great software no longer has to cost a fortune or consume every hour of your day. With Claude Code, you get an engineering partner that plans, builds, tests, and ships alongside you at a fraction of the time and cost. This isn't about prompting an AI. It's about designing systems that multiply what you can deliver. Welcome to the new standard.

Agentic software engineering is a discipline shift, and once you experience it, there's no going back. Instead of spending days on tasks that take agents minutes, you orchestrate workflows that reduce cost, eliminate repetition, and scale your output without scaling your team. The developers who master this don't just move faster. They do more with less, and they do it consistently.

Across 11 hands-on modules, you'll go from Claude Code fundamentals to production-grade multi-agent pipelines. You'll design composable skills, build MCP tools that connect agents to real systems, architect parallel sub-agent workflows, and harden everything for real-world conditions. Every module is built around genuine engineering decisions, because the goal was never to write more code. It was always to build software that matters.


| Module | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| [01 Fundamentals](/demos/01-fundamentals/readme.md) | Claude product family, installation and authentication, context engineering with CLAUDE.md |
| [02 Harness](/demos/02-harness/readme.md) | Settings hierarchy, custom slash commands, and event-driven hooks |
| [03 Skills](/demos/03-skills/readme.md) | Skill anatomy, invocation model, authoring by hand and from a conversation |
| [04 MCP](/demos/04-mcp/readme.md) | MCP architecture, connecting remote endpoints, wrapping REST APIs as servers |
| [05 CLI](/demos/06-automate-cli/readme.md) | Headless `-p` runs, tool scoping, parallel isolation, and long-running goal patterns |
| [06 Sub-agents and Agent Teams](/demos/05-subagents-agent-teams/readme.md) | Sub-agent frontmatter, tool restriction, and orchestrator decomposition patterns; lead, teammates, shared task list and mailbox, and where a team beats a sub-agent |
| [07 Optimize and Observability](/demos/07-optimize-observability/readme.md) | Prompt audit, caveman compression, the autoresearch promote/revert loop, prompt injection, hook guardrails, and tracing |
| [08 Distribution](/demos/08-distribution/readme.md) | Plugin manifests, converting a `.claude/` config, and marketplace catalogs |
| [09 Agentic DevOps](/demos/09-agentic-devops/readme.md) | Containerized deploy to a plain Ubuntu host over SSH, with the agent proving the result |
| [10 Agent SDK & Managed Agents](/demos/10-sdk-managed-agents/readme.md) | The `query()` async iterator, session resume, custom tools and typed output, then cloud containers, mid-execution steering via SSE, and multiagent with outcomes and memory |
| [11 Planning](/demos/11-planning/readme.md) | Optional. Plan Mode mechanics, decomposition, and independently verifiable sub-agent packages |
